title.narrative:
EURIZ-

The project will seek to support financially underserved MSMEs by issuing different type of guarantees (portfolio, individual and counter guarantees) to Partner Financial Institutions and Local Guarantee Funds (LGFs). The project has also an Autonomous Technical Assistance Component for capacity building to be provided to the PFIs and LGFs to ensure the development of know-how in the market, and to MSMEs to enhance their capabilities in building consistent financial statements.

description.narrative: Access to finance: number of Micro Small Medium Entreprises (MSMEs) provided with access to loans and other financial services, disaggregated by sex and age (1530 years) and regions

comment.narrative: In terms of sectors targeted this sample that will be more robust as part of the next reporting cycle gives us some evidence on the main beneficiaries of the EURIZ guarantees5 incomplete data as 29.5 of the number of MSMEs is reported as others and thus undefined representing 15.4 of the loans granted The main sector served is agriculture and agro industry with 28 of the loan amounts and 23.6 of the MSMEs served through EURIZ The first segment served in number of MSMEs is womenowned or led MSMEs 51 of shareholding or 20 of shareholding and general manager are women representing 159 MSMEs 30.2 of the final beneficiaries but only 13.4 of the loan amounts On the other side health MSMEs are important in terms of loan amounts the majority of individual guarantees signed are in the health sector and being only 9 MSMEs 1.7 they represent 22.8 of the loans.Other sectors represented are 16 socialinclusive businesses for 7.4 of the loan amounts 19 education MSMEs for 8 of the portfolio amount and also 6 green MSMEs 6 youth MSMEs 30 startups and 1 digital MSME.

comment.narrative: Target set as 31122040 but not possible. Set to the latest date possible.

The current value includes the baseline. Based on Results Reporting Round 8 the value for EU RF Number of jobs supported sustained by the EU was 768 i.e. 26518 minus the baseline. Quality control comment August 2023 Following this comment the value has been modified from 26518 gross number with baseine included to 768 jobs without the baseline. When reporting EURF values the value need to be removed.
